summary.text: Jon Patterson is a Republican state representative from Missouri House District 30, which he has represented since 2019, and is the Republican candidate for Missouri Senate District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jon Patterson is not running for re-election to House District 30 in 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the Joint Committee on Capitol Security, and in 2021-2022 he was vice chair of the Emerging Issues Committee.
